_note:
Slots for [brg_careers-apply]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {{token}} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Defaults are the exact production copy. Slot names are underscore-only — a hyphen fills fine but generates an invalid ACF field name, and build-acf.py now refuses it (conti 2026-08-13). `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write a literal `&` and a literal `—`, NEVER `&` or `—` (both would double-escape and render as visible entity text). DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED, per conti's ruling (c) 2026-08-13: (1) the

— it carries BOTH a structural
and an inline for the pink marker block, and no slot type can express either. `text` escapes them into visible markup; `html`/wysiwyg returns

-wrapped content. The field could not express the design, so the headline stays as code. (2) the four-item offer

    — unlike community-stats' 2x2 grid, four is NOT a design constant here, it is a `display:grid` list that would happily take a fifth. Numbering these slots would bake the row count into the fragment while LOOKING editable, so adding a benefit would become a code change. Left honestly as code.

heading_1.label: Heading
heading_1.doc: The section heading. PRESS RETURN to break the line exactly where you want it. The highlighted words are a separate box below, so that the mark can follow them.

heading_mark.label: Heading — the marked words
heading_mark.doc: The words the highlight sits behind. Keep it short: the mark is drawn to the width of these words, and a long phrase stretches it thin.

body_1.label: Body copy — first paragraph
body_1.doc: Left column, opening paragraph. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write an em dash as a literal —, not —.
body_1.default: This isn't your average restaurant gig. At BRG, we invest in our people — with real training, real growth paths, and a culture that actually lives up to the hype.

body_2.label: Body copy — second paragraph
body_2.doc: Left column, second paragraph. The two paragraphs are separate fields because the two-paragraph break is layout, not content.
body_2.default: Whether you're starting your first job in hospitality or you're a seasoned operator looking for your next move, there's a place for you here. We promote from within, develop leaders intentionally, and build teams that stick around.

offers_heading.label: Right column heading
offers_heading.doc: Sits above the asterisk-bulleted list. Short — it renders in the display face at up to 2.2rem, so ~14 characters keeps it on one line. The list items themselves are not editable; they are code.

offers.label: Bullet points under that heading
offers.doc:
The list under the heading above. These were built into the page and could not be edited, which is what sent you looking for them.

UNTIL YOU ADD THE FIRST ONE HERE the page keeps showing the four it has always shown: Competitive pay; Growth and advancement opportunities across multiple brands and locations; A team-first culture that takes your development seriously; The chance to work in restaurants that people genuinely love. Add a bullet and this list takes over completely, so add all the ones you want, not just the one you are changing.

text.label: Bullet
text.doc: One line of the list. Plain text; a star is drawn automatically, so do not type one.

cta_label.label: Button label
cta_label.doc: Black-bordered button at the foot of the section. ~18 characters.

cta_href.label: Button link
cta_href.doc: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the open-positions section below. A full URL works too.

hl_variant.label: Highlight animation
hl_variant.doc: How the marker highlight behind “to work here” arrives. `h3` (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. `h1` background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP. `h0` static, no animation, which is what this mark did before. Unknown or blank renders a static painted mark, never blank. Color and padding are unchanged from the original design. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

section_bg.label: Section background
section_bg.doc: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below.

section_bg_opacity.label: Background strength
section_bg_opacity.doc: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

section_bg_px.label: Background movement
section_bg_px.doc: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

section_bg_px_dir.label: Background movement direction
section_bg_px_dir.doc: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

section_bg_mobile.label: Section background — phones
section_bg_mobile.doc: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

mark_1_ast_art.label: Artwork
mark_1_ast_art.doc: Which mark is drawn here. Leave it alone to keep the one the design uses. Any SVG or PNG from the media library works; SVG stays crisp at any size.

mark_1_ast_pos.label: Position
mark_1_ast_pos.doc: Where the mark sits in its section. "Where the design put it" is the starting point and leaves it exactly where it is now — choose one of the nine only when you want to move it. Corners sit inside the section padding, so a long headline cannot push a mark down into the type.

mark_1_ast_opacity.label: Opacity
mark_1_ast_opacity.doc: How solid the mark is. 100 is as drawn; lower settles it into the background.

mark_1_ast_show.label: Show this mark
mark_1_ast_show.doc: Hiding removes just this one mark. Nothing else in the section changes.

mark_1_ast_anim.label: Animation
mark_1_ast_anim.doc: How the mark moves. "As built" keeps what it does today — a hard-cut jitter for most, a spin for the asterisk in the hero cluster. Still stops it entirely. Anyone who has switched off animation in their system settings sees it still whatever is chosen here.

btn_color.label: Button color
btn_color.doc: The button's color. "As designed" is the starting point and leaves this section's buttons exactly as they look today — which matters, because several sections paint theirs black on purpose and the give-back slider alternates yellow and black down the slides. Choose a color and it takes over. The words flip to black or white automatically, whichever reads on the color you pick. This applies to every button in this section.

btn_style.label: Filled or outline
btn_style.doc: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind — useful over a photo, where a solid block can sit heavily. "As designed" leaves it as it is today, which is filled everywhere. Both are exactly the same size, so switching one does not move anything around it.

btn_effect.label: Hover effect
btn_effect.doc:
What the button does when someone points at it. Lift is what every button does today — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so it is the one to pair with Outline above. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal and is not changed here. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.
